title: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf who recovers the Moonsilver Key from Olivia with her wolves and completes the ritual that returns the sun to Innistrad.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar who fights in the ballroom beside Chandra and says a tender goodbye to her at the end.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer who burns vampires in the ballroom and parts from Adeline after the ritual.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who holds the line and later says farewell to Arlinn, offering her expertise with ghosts.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who slows enemies and later borrows the Moonsilver Key to study its temporal properties; he warns Arlinn of Phyrexians.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who heals himself with the blood of a pit, defeats Edgar in the ballroom and spares his life.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather, who fights for his marriage to Olivia and flees when he loses to Sorin.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire lady who drops the Moonsilver Key and flees through a window when the wolves arrive.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A werewolf who leads wolves to Voldaren Manor to help Arlinn against the vampires, though she says this changes nothing between them.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: The witch whose spirit is bound to the Moonsilver Key until she returns to her body and leads the ritual.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel fighting in the ballroom who catches a demon swinging a column.

entities.name: Boulder
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who returns to her side.

entities.name: Patience
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who returns to her side.

entities.name: Streak
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who returns to her side.

entities.name: Redtooth
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who returns to her side.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A woman Sorin once trusted who locked him in stone.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel Sorin created and later unmade.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Threat of flesh, metal and black oil that Teferi warns Arlinn about.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: The witches whose joined magic raises the Moonsilver Key at the ritual.

entities.name: Tovolar's wolves
entities.description: Dozens of wolves who pour into Voldaren Manor and fight the vampires.

entities.name: Mondronen Howlpack
entities.description: Tovolar's pack, which Arlinn says he rebuilt out of fear.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The key Olivia drops and Arlinn recovers, then used with the Sungold Lock; Teferi borrows it afterward.

entities.name: Sungold Lock
entities.description: The lock joined with the Moonsilver Key to complete the ritual.

entities.name: The Celestus
entities.description: The ancient machine that roars to life and brings the sun back.

entities.name: Voldaren Manor
entities.description: Olivia's manor where the battle is fought.

entities.name: Sanguitorium
entities.description: The blood cellar where Sorin was thrown and heals.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Sorin's home, where the wounded recover after the battle.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: The region where the ritual is completed and the sun rises.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: The region where Voldaren Manor stands.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane whose sun returns.

entities.name: Harvesttide Massacre
entities.description: The attack for which Arlinn wants Tovolar to pay.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The earlier catastrophe in which friend and foe were hard to tell apart.

events.summary: Adeline, Chandra, Kaya and Teferi fight vampires in the ballroom and discuss whether to help Arlinn.
events.quote: "Arlinn knows what she's doing," Kaya says.

events.summary: A massive wolf blocks a javelin and dozens of wolves pour into the ballroom, led by Tovolar, who nods that he is here to help.
events.quote: There must be dozens of wolves pouring in now

events.summary: Kaya points Tovolar to the door where Arlinn went, and he bounds toward her.
events.quote: Tovolar's gone the second she's done talking

events.summary: Sorin, lying in a pit of blood, reflects on Nahiri and Avacyn and his grandfather's betrayal, then drinks the blood to heal.
events.quote: They thought this cellar would drown him, but it's only made him stronger.

events.summary: Sorin climbs out of the pit and heads for the ballroom, no longer caring about the family there.
Sorin cuts through the guards and duels his grandfather Edgar, defeating him.
events.quote: In the end, it is Edgar who falls from the rumble first

events.summary: Sorin spares Edgar's life and tells him to get out of his sight; Edgar flees.
events.quote: Sorin scowls. "Go. Get out of my sight."

events.summary: Arlinn dreams of forests and wakes to find Tovolar and her four wolves around her.
events.quote: When she opens her eyes, Tovolar is the first thing she sees

events.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar their grievance is unsettled and he proposes that they settle it afterward.
events.quote: "Tovolar," she says, "this doesn't change anything between us.

events.summary: Arlinn and her wolves track Olivia and corner her with Edgar, and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key and flees.
Arlinn takes the key in her teeth and tells Tovolar to come find her later.
events.quote: Arlinn wraps the key with a length of torn curtain and picks it up between her teeth.

events.summary: On the journey from Stensia to Kessig, Arlinn tells Katilda about Tovolar and werewolf fear and how Harvesttide set things back.
events.quote: "It isn't until you get some distance that you realize they're wrong.

events.summary: At the Celestus Arlinn joins the key and the Sungold Lock, and the Celestus roars to life.
events.quote: But that worry dies the instant gold meets silver.

events.summary: A column of light runs to the moon and the sun rises over Innistrad for the first time in months.
events.quote: Together they watch the first sunrise over Innistrad in months.

events.summary: Arlinn says farewell to her friends, and Kaya leaves, promising to return for ghost business.
events.quote: "It's been nice working with you, Arlinn."

events.summary: Teferi borrows the Moonsilver Key and warns Arlinn about Phyrexians.

relations.quote: His grandfather, who even now fought for the dreadful privilege of marrying Olivia Voldaren.
fought for the dreadful privilege of marrying Olivia Voldaren
A woman who locked him in stone and forced him to watch the Plane crumble.

relations.note: Uneasy temporary allies against Olivia, with a grievance still unsettled.

relations.quote: Boulder's at her side, too—they all are.

relations.note: Katilda follows the group and advises Arlinn.
relations.quote: "I would give you advice, Arlinn," Katilda says.
"Nice working with you, too," Arlinn says.

relations.note: They embrace in parting beneath a willow.
relations.quote: only just barely make out their embrace

relations.note: He rebuilt the pack out of fear.
relations.quote: "Tovolar rebuilt the Mondronen Howlpack out of fear," Arlinn begins.
